lines: I kept drawing line after line, then the next, then the next.
I’ll draw the next destination.
Treasure Island
If I take you with me just as we are
When I draw carefully, carefully, carefully
with lines that shake and tremble
When I draw carefully, carefully, carefully
I had decided.
The next, the next, the next are still not the destination.
I’ll look for the scenery of a dream.
Treasure Island
If I take you with me just as we are
When I sing carefully, carefully, carefully
even if it shakes and trembles
When I sing carefully, carefully, carefully
I had decided, but
I’ll take you with me just as we are.
I’ll draw carefully, carefully, carefully.
even if it shakes and trembles
I’ll sing carefully, carefully, carefully.
Even so, I’ll take you with me.
with lines that shake and tremble
I’ll draw.
your song.
